name: Jokko ChatBot
author: Jokko

sections.description:
Jokko ChatBot lets you connect your Jokko assistant to any WordPress site without editing theme files.

After activation, enter your ChatBot ID and Tenant ID in the plugin settings page and the Jokko widget will load automatically on the front end.

Features

  • AI-powered customer support widget
  • Fast setup from the WordPress admin area
  • Automatic widget loading on your website
  • Mobile-friendly chat experience
  • Compatible with common WordPress themes and plugins

How it works

  1. Create your account on https://jokko.chat
  2. Configure your chatbot in the Jokko dashboard
  3. Install and activate this plugin
  4. Copy your ChatBot ID and Tenant ID from Jokko
  5. Paste them into Settings > Jokko ChatBot
  6. Save the settings to publish the widget

External Services

This plugin connects to the Jokko service to load and display the chat widget on your site.

It loads a JavaScript widget file from api.jokko.chat when the widget is enabled and a page is viewed.

It sends your configured ChatBot ID, Tenant ID and the API endpoint needed to initialize the widget. When visitors load a page with the widget enabled or start a conversation, their browser may send data directly to Jokko, including IP address, browser metadata, page URL, referrer, chat messages, and any personal data they submit in the chat.

This service is provided by Jokko:
Terms of Service: https://jokko.chat/legal/terms
Privacy Policy: https://jokko.chat/legal/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the ZIP from the WordPress admin screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > Jokko ChatBot.
  4. Enter your ChatBot ID and Tenant ID.
  5. Save your settings.
sections.faq:
Where can I find my ChatBot ID and Tenant ID?

Log in to https://jokko.chat, open your chatbot configuration, and copy the identifiers from the widget or integration section.

Is the plugin free?

The WordPress plugin is free to install. You need an active Jokko account to use the chatbot service.

Can I temporarily disable the widget?

Yes. Open Settings > Jokko ChatBot and disable the widget without uninstalling the plugin.

Does the widget affect performance?

The widget script is loaded asynchronously to minimize impact on page performance.

Does it work on mobile devices?

Yes. The Jokko widget is responsive and works on phones and tablets.
